root_decision: Retain all stock commands and all planned four regression commands unchanged. No alternate artifact generation or omitted ordinary full gate adopted.
findings: Stock ordinary builds explicit +Module targets using Lake mod.leanArts. These request olean, ilean, C output, setup metadata and JSON diagnostics.
+Module:olean still fetches leanArts, so this facet does not avoid the other work.
Stock --rehash sets trustHash=false and reads artifact bytes for new and reused dependency modules; separate stock integrity guards also hash project outputs.
The displayed Lake module build duration excludes waiting for prerequisite module jobs, but includes its own setup/compiler/output hashes/trace.
Code inspection alone does not establish the cause of current timing differences.

A direct lean -o primitive exists, but it was not adopted: the approved plan uses Lake +ProofAudit to retain complete artifact/trace groups, consistent with the stock checker warning against writing an olean behind Lake.
Recovery requirements explicitly require a distinct genuine guarded ordinary full when normal outputs are needed for negative audit. Ordinary full therefore remains mandatory.
